public interface elemConn_C0

Build one-based tensor-product element connectivity.

These constructors describe a regular positive-degree layout: each directional count must satisfy nnode=nelem*p+1 with p>=1. Overloads accept scalar counts for curves and directional counts for surfaces or volumes. Direction 1 varies fastest in every element row. Use elemConn_Cn or the rank-specific NURBS cmp_elem bindings for arbitrary knot vectors, repeated knots, or degree-zero spaces.
